coverage: Regional report; numerical extraction remains incomplete.
report_note: A recent all-province, all-language speaker count was not verified. The published census-language baseline used by the linked spatial study is 1965; the study explains that later language questions were not publicly tabulated. A newly drawn map using it is historical.
regional_report: A 2025 Kurdish-language survey reports participants' language proficiency and use, but samples Kurdish mother-tongue speakers and cannot supply population shares for every province. The 2024 Mendeley deposit preserves 1927–1965 census tables; its deposit date must not be mistaken for a new enumeration. Current regional totals remain an evidence gap.
